in_sanskrit.name: निलाय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: गोचरती निले गृहम् (Going or flowing to a blue or dark abode or dwelling place)

in_hindi.name: निलाया
in_hindi.long_meaning: काली गृह (Blue or dark abode or dwelling place)

in_tamil.name: நிலைய
in_tamil.long_meaning: முக்கிய அருவம் அல்லது கடலில் அல்லது அருகில் வசனம் (Abigo, the vast expanse or the deep blue sea or the blue hill)

in_telugu.name: నిలய
in_telugu.long_meaning: దూరేపొయ్య బీజ గృహముదు (A blue or dark abode or dwelling place that is far away)

in_marathi.name: Nilaya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Heaven, Abode of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nilaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Nilaya is the abode of gods, the celestial heaven. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nilaya', meaning 'abode' or 'dwelling place'. It is believed that the name imbues a sense of peace, spirituality, and connection to the divine.
